title: Anthive
intro: A colony of ants learns, from rewards alone, to bring food home and build bridges from planks. Every ant runs the same small policy: there is no leader and no hand-written route.

entries.name: hex-1c-g1-20261007-125221
entries.title: Finding food
entries.blurb: Ten ants fan out from their nest, find food, and learn to bring it home together.

rows.caption: A mature colony on dry ground

entries.name: hex-2-dp025-sp6-20261007-150023
entries.title: A wide river
entries.blurb: Food is beyond a three-cell river. The colony carries planks to the bank, builds a crossing, then makes the return trip with food.

rows.caption: A complete crossing of a three-cell river

entries.name: hex-3-dp025-20261007-161241
entries.title: Many ways across
entries.blurb: One policy faces dry maps and rivers up to four cells wide, with planks scattered across the land. This colony builds a full crossing and brings every food item home.

rows.caption: A four-cell river, seven bridges, and all food delivered
